blocks.html: There’s no single way to celebrate Christmas, and if you’re the type who would never go for clichés, then you’ll certainly enjoy the many ways Robinsons Malls is marking this yuletide season with delightful displays. Make Robinsons Malls your go-to place for the holidays and this Christmas will surely become more memorable, more spectacular, and more special than ever!
HOLIDAY ATRIUM DECOR
With the exciting combination of color, patterns, and symbols at Robinsons Malls atriums, you’ll be inspired to celebrate the holidays in the most exceptional way: your way!
CELEBRATE THE HOLIDAYS BOHEMIAN-STYLE AT ROBINSONS MALLS

You know that the yuletide season is here when the atrium of Robinsons Malls is filled with bright colors and glittering décor. This year, the atrium décor in Robinsons Malls takes on a Bohemian style, as seen in the vivacious jewel colors, radiating patterns, and gleaming textures that characterize this eclectic design theme. Take inspiration from an explosion of bright-colored spangles, geometric florals, and arching curls and waves, as you celebrate the season in your own unique way!
GIANT CHRISTMAS TREES
The perfect background for your Instagram photo is this giant Christmas tree at Robinsons Galleria.
SNAP A PIC AT THE PICTURE-PERFECT CHRISTMAS TREE AT ROBINSONS GALLERIA

Always ready with your camera for a quick snapshot? The elegant 32-foot Christmas tree at Robinsons Galleria makes for the perfect background for your Instagram photos—guaranteed to get the most likes! This majestic, custom-made tree manufactured in Europe breaks the tradition of a garland Christmas tree, and features intricate ornaments and shining, shimmering lights.
Feel like you just stepped into a fairytale when you take in the sights at the enchanted fairy display with a towering Christmas tree at Robinsons Place Magnolia.
HAVE AN ENCHANTED CHRISTMAS AT ROBINSONS PLACE MAGNOLIA

Step into a magical world at Robinsons Place Magnolia! Its enchanted Christmas display features a mushroom fairy house and a fairy garden lit up with a rainbow of colors, where fairies move gracefully as they go about their mystical chores. Butterflies with intricately adorned wings, and multi-colored giant flowers and mushrooms are also strewn across the garden. Beside the garden stands the centerpiece: a towering 36-foot Christmas tree laden with Christmas ornaments, and sparkling flowers and butterflies in every hue. Watch out for fairies sprinkling pixie dust around the tree!
The Sweet Delights tree, on display at select Robinsons Malls, will have you craving for cupcakes, candies, and more!
THE SWEET DELIGHTS TREE SPREADS CHRISTMAS CHEER AT ROBINSONS MALLS

The traditional red Christmas tree is back once again at select Robinsons Malls—with a sweet twist! Aside from flowers, ribbons, and Christmas balls, the tree is also adorned with decorative dainty cupcakes and mouth-watering candies in a combination of red, white, and mint green colors.
The Holiday Sweet Delights tree will be displayed at Robinsons Nova Market, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Tacloban, Robinsons Place Antique, Robinsons Place Iligan, and Robinsons Place Pavia.
Get ready to be tempted to take a bite of this fairytale-inspired Gingerbread Christmas Tree at select Robinsons Malls this December.
CATCH THIS YUMMY-LOOKING GINGERBREAD CHRISTMAS TREE AT ROBINSONS MALLS

Whisk some fun into your Christmas celebration this year and visit the Gingerbread Christmas Tree at select Robinsons Malls! Inspired by the well-loved fairytale, “Hansel and Gretel,” this Christmas tree is set amidst gingerbread houses, and decorated with pastel-colored sugary lollipops, fluffy cupcakes, and ice cream trees flavored with fruit and spices. Adding to its charm are the giant snowflakes, Christmas leaves, and flower ornaments.

The Gingerbread Tree will be displayed at Robinsons Place GenSan, Robinsons Forum, Robinsons Place Starmills, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Robinsons Place Butuan, Robinsons Place Iloilo, Robinsons Place Dumaguete, Robinsons North Tacloban, and Robinsons Place Tuguegarao.
Giant gift boxes may look like typical holiday décor—but wait until you see what’s inside!
A magical reflective room filled with festive, colorful balls in different sizes provides the perfect backdrop for your selfies.
With memorable Christmas songs playing in the background, this room features glittery and dreamy Christmas elements like snowflakes and stars.
EXPERIENCE MAGIC AT HOLIDAY INFINITY ROOMS IN ROBINSONS PLACE LIPA AND ROBINSONS PLACE DASMARIÑAS

Who wouldn’t want to capture the perfect moment with friends and family in a beautiful snapshot, especially this time of the year? At Robinsons Place Lipa and Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, you can take the perfect selfie against the most amazing backdrops: the Robinsons Holiday Infinity Rooms! Take out your camera and choose the background for your Christmas selfie: inside a giant red and white gift box; a magical reflective room filled with festive, colorful balls in varying sizes; or a room teeming with glittery and dreamy snowflakes and stars as memorable Christmas songs play in the background. Create wonderful memories this holiday season and make those selfies last a lifetime!
HOLIDAY DIGITAL SHOW
“A VERY MERRY DIGITAL SHOW” AT ROBINSONS MALLS FEATURES AMAZING EFFECTS

You’re in for a unique experience as Robinsons Malls premieres its first-ever digital show in time for the holidays! Dubbed as “A Very Merry Digital Show,” it features the latest and most creative technologies such as laser mapping, 2D motion graphics, 3D animation, and longer than life background graphics, all in sync with the show’s production numbers.

Enjoy livewire interactive performances from the Buganda dancers, and dance along to all-time favorite Christmas tunes such as “Kumukuti-kutitap” and “Jingle Bells.” Be captivated by musical renditions from up and coming singers Melbelline, Nasser, Hazel Faith, Daniel, and Natasia—all performing upbeat melodies against dazzling laser-mapped backgrounds.
Indeed, it’s a one-of-a-kind, totally digital experience that will surely leave you mesmerized.

Bring your family to watch “A Very Merry Digital Show” this Christmas season at Robinsons Malls! Schedules are as follows: November 30, at Robinsons Forum, December 1 at Robinsons Place Dasmarinas, December 2, Robinsons Place General Trias, December 7, Robinsons Malolos, December 8, Robinsons Place Lipa, December 9, Robnsons Place Antipolo, December 15, Robinsons Place Imus, December 16, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, December 19, Robinsons Place Las Pinas and December 22 Robinsons Metroeast.
Mall shows are at 5:30 p.m. and 7 p.m.
An impressive array of musical and LED dance performances set against a dazzling interactive background composed of 2D motion graphics and laser mapping.
